pages.title: The Herald sequence
pages.text: “When the world changes for no apparent reason, do not search for an explanation. Search for what is approaching.”$(br2)The sequence is fixed:$(br)$(#1C7FA8)Herald of Storm → Herald of Hunger → Herald of Cold → repeat.$(br2)Only one Herald can exist in the world at a time. When you win or die, the Herald disappears and the cycle advances. If you lose, it does not drop its heart.

pages.title: Battle advice
pages.text: What each Herald does, how it is weak and which abilities to use against it, I wrote down in the $(thing)Bestiary of the Beyond$(). Read it before the first encounter: there may be no time later.
